fields.title: 9. 3 data points to check directly before the next issue (monthly 2026-12, 12/01)
fields.md:
1. **NAACP lawsuit preliminary injunction ruling and the text of the order** — If a stop-operation order is issued, which Colossus 2 turbines (temporary vs. MDEQ-permitted permanent) would be halted, and whether that reaches the 4Q26 nameplate GW (management statement: about 3GW by end-2026 — candidate table). Court records + 10-K legal proceedings note ([Earthjustice case library](https://earthjustice.org/library/?_case=xai-caa-enforcement) · [10-Q R25](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R25.htm)).
2. **Whether the Boost/EchoStar deal (T9) is disclosed** — SpaceX and EchoStar 8-Ks, FCC license transfer applications, Boost subscribers and 'SpaceX reimbursement' in EchoStar's 3Q26 10-Q ([SpaceX EDGAR](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json) · [EchoStar EDGAR](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001415404.json)).
3. **Keep existing checkpoints for T3, T4, T7, T8** — Flight 15 FAA license and LL2 result (12/01) · Amazon LV-01 (11/13) · LE-04 (11/23) · T7 ⓓ 11/5 · ⓔ 11/6 · ⓒ 11/18 · T8 ② deposit 11/4 · acceptance 11/5 ([FAA Starship license](https://www.faa.gov/space/stakeholder_engagement/spacex_starship) · `data/spacex_watch.json launches.competitor_next` · [DA 26-1078](https://docs.fcc.gov/public/attachments/DA-26-1078A1.txt)).
